title: Manufacturing Operations Director
text:
**Director, Manufacturing Operations**
—lead end-to-end operations for a flexible packaging manufacturing network, setting the strategic direction while actively managing day-to-day performance across business units and plants.
 
 
You’ll own the results that matter: ensuring
**safety**
and compliance, driving
**quality**
outcomes, meeting
**delivery**
expectations, and improving
**cost**
performance. Through strong operational leadership, you’ll translate company goals into practical execution and measurable improvements.
 
 
Continuous improvement is central to the role. You’ll identify waste, strengthen processes, and help scale best practices using data-driven problem-solving. You’ll also champion
**sustainability**
initiatives and support
**advanced materials and packaging innovation**
, partnering to evaluate new approaches and translate them into manufacturing reality.
 
 
Working closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams, you’ll enable smooth product launches, optimize production and handoffs, and develop high-performing teams that operate within a collaborative, safety-first culture.
